summary: All nine standard animation rows are readable and preserve the strict two-head female blue-haired scholar identity. Fan, hair ornaments, and tassels remain attached and coherent. All 16 look directions communicate clockwise gaze semantics; diagonal classifier warnings are acceptable near-front stylized ambiguity, not blocking defects.
strengths: Consistent blue-haired female scholar silhouette, proportions, palette, and costume across all rows
Fan and tassel remain in the intended hand position without floating, mirroring, or detachment
Standard states are visually distinct: calm idle, directional running, wave, jump, failed, waiting, running, and review
Cardinal directions are clear and intermediate directions progress coherently without back views
Atlas and cardinal hard gates pass with clean transparent extraction

issues.detail: Automated continuity reports local pixel-difference and center-shift outliers at several diagonal/cardinal transitions; the contact sheets show these as stylized pose/gaze interpolation changes rather than broken registration.

issues.location: Blind direction validation horizontal pairs 6-7 and vertical pair 4
issues.detail: The automated classifier flips some near-front diagonal labels, while independent blind verdicts identify the intended left/right and up/down semantics; ambiguity is expected at these shallow diagonals.

issues.location: Direction continuity alpha-hole checks at 000, 157.5, and 202.5
issues.detail: Small transparent rows occur in the lower leg/skirt negative space and read as intentional openings, not accidental holes through a filled body.
